This template is to be used for citing the [[Arena News]] articles on ''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''{{'}} [https://starwarshunters.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{ArenaNews|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://starwarshunters.com/arena-news/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{ArenaNews|url=0122de64c2544c938cd376a6e9cc75f3-en-gb|text=First Edition}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{ArenaNews|url=0122de64c2544c938cd376a6e9cc75f3-en-gb|text=First Edition}}
